newsitem.title: USA: National Home Health to buy back shares.
newsitem.headline: National Home Health to buy back shares.

text.p: National Home Health Care Corp said on Tuesday its board of directors has authorized the repurchase of up to $1 million of its common stock.
Purchases would be made from time to time in the open market and through privately negotiated transactions, subject to general market and other conditions, the company said in a statement.
The company estimated that purchases, which will be financed from existing cash, would be made over a period of approximately one year.
One stated purpose of the repurchase program is to make shares available for later issue upon the exercise of stock options and for other corporate purposes, the company said.
